content.short: Zerion is a smart crypto wallet and all-in-one DeFi portfolio manager supporting everything on-chain including Mantle assets, NFTs, and DeFi positions.
content.description: Zerion is a non-custodial smart wallet and comprehensive Web3 portfolio management platform trusted by over 2 million users. The Zerion wallet tracks tokens, NFTs, DeFi positions, and yield across 10+ blockchains from a single unified interface. Users can swap tokens through Zerion's aggregator, bridge assets cross-chain, explore new DeFi opportunities, and track historical portfolio performance with P&L analytics. Zerion is officially recognized by Mantle Network and supports the complete Mantle DeFi ecosystem with full asset visibility and interaction capabilities.
content.meta: Zerion is a smart wallet and DeFi portfolio tracker supporting all Mantle assets and positions on-chain. Discover Zerion on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
